question: Fresh test of the third shrink rule and of undo by height. Shrinking, among blocks starting at the new end or lower: those above the old end rise to the new end, stacking only on shared columns; those at or past it rise by the rows from new end to old end, both counted, with no such block, at most the fall. First undo: rows fall by the height lost, rounded up. Varied: block mixes in the band, tall Shape and Image in the band, spare rows, text lower down, Backspace, read while typing, phone with a Button.
